3.3.3p2 Security fixes and a new security check page

Manage your servers directly through your browser.

ISPConfig is an open source hosting control panel for Linux. Websites, email, DNS, databases, FTP and shell users on a single server or spread across a multiserver setup, all managed from one interface.

Download ISPConfig 3.3.3p2
BSD licensed Debian · Ubuntu · AlmaLinux · Rocky Linux
https://server1.example.com:8080/
40,000+downloads per month
22interface languages
4login levels, from admin to mailbox user
1 → nservers from one panel

What it manages

The services a hosting server runs, in one panel

ISPConfig writes the configuration for the daemons that are already on your server. No proprietary stack, no lock-in: the setup stays a normal Linux system you can inspect and repair by hand.

Websites

Apache or nginx vhosts, several PHP versions per server with PHP-FPM, Let's Encrypt certificates (RSA and ECC), subdomains, alias domains, redirects and protected folders.

Email

Postfix and Dovecot with virtual mailboxes, aliases and forwards. rspamd spam filtering with greylisting, DKIM signing, DMARC, autoresponders and Mailman lists.

DNS

BIND or PowerDNS with a zone wizard, DNSSEC, zone file import and primary/secondary servers. All common record types including CAA, DMARC and SRV.

Databases

MariaDB and MySQL databases and users per website. Since ISPConfig 3.3 also PostgreSQL, with phpMyAdmin and pgAdmin access from the panel.

Multiserver

Control dedicated web, mail, DNS and database Service Nodes from one Management Server, or mirror servers for a cluster setup. Physical machines and VMs work the same way.

Resellers and clients

Separate logins for admins, resellers, clients and mail users. Client templates and limits control what every account can create.

Shell, FTP and cron

Jailed and regular SSH/SFTP users with key login, PureFTPd accounts and cron jobs, each bound to the website they belong to.

Monitoring

Load, memory and traffic graphs on the dashboard, service status, mail queue and log views, traffic and disk quotas per site.

Remote API and CLI

A SOAP/REST remote API for provisioning from shops and billing systems, and the ispc command line tool for scripted tasks.

Full feature list

Installation

A fresh server to a working panel in one command

The ISPConfig Autoinstaller sets up the complete server: web server, PHP, mail, DNS, database, FTP, firewall and the control panel itself.

Start from a minimal Debian or Ubuntu installation and pass options to choose nginx or Apache, the PHP versions or a mail-only setup. Updates to a new ISPConfig release are done with one command, too.

Autoinstaller guide All installation guides
root@server1: ~bash

# Install on a fresh Debian or Ubuntu server

$ wget -O - https://get.ispconfig.org | sh -s -- --help

# Update an existing installation

$ ispconfig_update.sh

DistributionVersions
Debian11 – 13Recommended
Ubuntu LTS22.04 – 26.04Recommended
AlmaLinux8 – 10
Rocky Linux8 – 10
CentOS8

Room to grow

Start with one.
Build a fleet.

A single server today. Dedicated web, mail and DNS servers tomorrow.

Manage your infrastructure from one ISPConfig interface on the Management Server. Add Service Nodes for your hosting services as your infrastructure grows.

Explore multiserver management

  • Single & multiserver
  • Physical & virtual machines

Extensions

Add what your hosting business needs

The control panel is free. Commercial extensions add billing, server migration and application management. They install from the extension repository under System › Extension Installer.

All extensions
Available Business

Billing Module

Invoicing, recurring billing and payment reminders inside the ISPConfig admin panel.

  • Recurring invoices from subscriptions
  • PDF invoices, credits and proforma invoices
  • PayPal payments and reminder system

€59 per server

Details
Available Migration

Migration Toolkit

Move servers from ISPConfig, Plesk, cPanel and Confixx to ISPConfig 3.x, or copy an installation as it is.

  • Migration Tool: import via the remote API
  • ISPCopy: 1:1 copy over SSH
  • Websites, mail, databases and DNS

€79 1 year, up to 10 source servers

Details
Beta Applications

WordPress Manager

Install, update and manage WordPress sites from within ISPConfig.

  • One-click installation and updates
  • Plugin and theme management
  • Installation templates

Price to be announced
